video_title: Kobe's Cousin: Where Were You When He Was Here?

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the emotional experience of joining the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I got my childhood friend, rest in peace Elden Campbell on the team.
quotes.quote: It was weird first, because you are a Laker, grew up being a Laker fan, and I got my childhood friend, rest in peace Elden Campbell on the team. Let's back it up to draft day, to big smooth. Jerry West was like, we got the last pick, we are going to pick you. If you are still on the board, we are going to pick you. And I am thinking, okay, it ain't going to happen. And the last pick, they select Elden Campbell. I am crying, but I am happy at the same time, because Elden grew up in Inglewood, Morningside High, right there. So I walk out the house crying, but I am like, damn, Elden going home. That's so dope.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on Kobe Bryant's maturity as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: The fact that how mature Kobe was at 17 was bananas.
quotes.quote: Before I got drafted, my agent was my cousin, Tony Bryant. He told me, we got a cousin that is dope. He overseas right now, but he going to come home. And when he come home, he going to take Philly by storm. So I knew about Kobe and being in the family. But then when we drafted him, I was like, oh shit. So I go to the press conference, and the fact that how mature Kobe was at 17 was bananas. It is like, I am an All-Star, I got MVP votes, I have been in the league, and I am trying to teach a young fella, and he teaching me.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson criticizes fans who only supported Kobe after his passing
quotes.excerpt: Stop talking about Kobe. Stop talking about him because politically, you got to because he passed.
quotes.quote: It is almost sacrilegious now to you motherfuckers that jump on showboats back now that he is gone. Man the fuck up. If you didn't like him, say you didn't like him. Don't jump on because politically, you got to because he passed the way he passed. And I hear motherfuckers talking about him all the time. I am like, you didn't like Kobe, and Kobe didn't like you. Why you? And I get it, but you weren't talking that shit when he was here.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Barnes on Vanessa Bryant's continued support for his children
quotes.excerpt: Vanessa picked up where Kobe because Kobe started giving the boy shoes at like four, five years old.
quotes.quote: To this day, Vanessa picked up where Kobe because Kobe started giving the boy shoes at like four, five years old. Just two days ago, Vanessa text me, hey did the boys get the so and so pack? I am like, no. She is like, oh shit, I got shoes. It is still because she knew how much they fucked with. Still to this day, she is picking up. But that is the one thing I take pride in and really hold close that I got to see the other side, similar to you. You got to see the other side. You saw the killer on the court, but you got to see the man off the court and the dad.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the Lakers' rookie hazing culture
quotes.excerpt: We didn't really have to haze him or nothing like that, and he was a cool dude.
quotes.quote: We didn't really have to haze him or nothing like that, and he was a cool dude. Like I said, he was really mature. Him and Derek Fisher and Travis Knight was a great bunch to come in with each other. They looked after each other. They was on that third squad. And you know, you been on the third squad. I don't know if you ever been on the third squad before. That's the one we hungry. The third squad, I was on the third squad in Miami, boy. Woof. That's probably where I made my biggest mistake as a player, man. I got in a fight with Bug, Tim Hardaway, man, just because I am on the third squad and no burn.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on Kobe Bryant's kindness and mean streak
quotes.excerpt: Stop talking about Shaq. Shaq was the nicest motherfucker. If he was mean, oh Lord.
quotes.quote: Stop talking about Shaq. Shaq was the nicest motherfucker. If he was mean, oh Lord. You are lucky he wasn't mean. You are lucky he wasn't mean. Like we I was in Dallas, rest in peace, Nelly. And Nelly, you know he got kooky shit. Said, you guarding Shaq, you starting, you going to guard Shaq. We end up winning the game, but the fact of the matter is, we win the game because Shaq was nice to me. I didn't hack a Shaq powerful. I just don't throw me, don't throw me, don't throw me across the street Shaq like that type of thing. And we was boys.
